A.unit_file:
# /etc/systemd/system/coldrevived-a.service
[Unit]
Description=ColdRevive daemon A (bt + nat punch-capable)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/cr-punch-pub/221
ExecStart=/opt/cr-punch-pub/221/coldrevived --config /opt/cr-punch-pub/221/config.json --node-id A --bind 0.0.0.0 --workdir /opt/cr-punch-pub/221
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
LimitNOFILE=65535
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
